+function GS2S_ItemSpell takes unit u, integer abilityId returns boolean
+    local integer i=0
+    local item it
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=6
+        set it=UnitItemInSlot(u,i)
+        if it!=null and LoadBoolean(GS2S_ItemData,GetItemTypeId(it),abilityId) then
+            set it=null
+            return true
+        endif
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    set it=null
+    return false
+endfunction
+function GS2S_RestoreLevels takes unit u returns nothing
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer lv
+    local integer i = 0
+    local integer abilityId
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= 5
+        if i == 0 then
+            set abilityId = 'A052'
+        elseif i == 1 then
+            set abilityId = 'A0PW'
+        elseif i == 2 then
+            set abilityId = 'A0P7'
+        elseif i == 3 then
+            set abilityId = 'A0PK'
+        else
+            set abilityId = 'A04T'
+        endif
+        set lv = LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, abilityId)
+        if lv > GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, abilityId) and not (abilityId == 'A0PK' and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'N03C') then
+            call UnitAddAbility(u, abilityId)
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u, abilityId, lv)
+        endif
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, abilityId) > lv then
+            call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, abilityId, GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, abilityId))
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+endfunction
+function GS2S_HeroUpdate takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetEnumUnit()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer form = GetUnitTypeId(u)
+    local integer previous = LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("form"))
+    local integer ultimateLevel
+    local integer researchLevel
+    local ability passiveButton
+    local real remainingCooldown
+    if form == 0 then
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS2S_Data, id)
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(GS2S_Heroes, u)
+        set u = null
+        return
+    endif
+    call GS2S_RestoreLevels(u)
+    set ultimateLevel = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0PK')
+    if form == 'N03C' then
+        set ultimateLevel = LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 'A0PK')
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0PK') > 0 then
+            if not LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateRemoved")) then
+                call SaveReal(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateReadyAt"), TimerGetElapsed(GS2S_Clock) + BlzGetUnitAbilityCooldownRemaining(u, 'A0PK'))
+            endif
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'A0PK')
+            call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateRemoved"), true)
+        endif
+    elseif LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateRemoved")) then
+        set remainingCooldown = LoadReal(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateReadyAt")) - TimerGetElapsed(GS2S_Clock)
+        if remainingCooldown > 0.00 and ultimateLevel > 0 then
+            call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u, 'A0PK', remainingCooldown)
+        endif
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateRemoved"), false)
+    endif
+    if previous != form then
+        call BlzSetAbilityResearchTooltip('A0PK', "오버 클록 배우기|cffffcc00(R)|r - [|cffffcc00레벨 %d|r]", 0)
+        call BlzSetAbilityTooltip('A0PK', "오버 클록|cffffcc00(R)|r - [|cffffcc00레벨 1|r]", 0)
+        call BlzSetAbilityTooltip('A0PK', "오버 클록|cffffcc00(R)|r - [|cffffcc00레벨 2|r]", 1)
+        call BlzSetAbilityTooltip('A0PK', "오버 클록|cffffcc00(R)|r - [|cffffcc00레벨 3|r]", 2)
+    endif
+    if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0QM') == 0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(u, 'A0QM')
+    endif
+    call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(u, true, 'A0QM')
+    if not LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageVisible")) then
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(u, 'A0QM', false)
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageVisible"), true)
+    endif
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(u), 'R07W', true) > 0 or LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageUnlocked")) then
+        if not LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageEnabled")) then
+            call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u, 'A0QM', false, false)
+            call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageEnabled"), true)
+        endif
+    elseif not LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageLocked")) then
+        call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u, 'A0QM', true, false)
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageLocked"), true)
+    endif
+    if previous != form or ultimateLevel != LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateLevel")) then
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(u, true, 'A0PK')
+        if form == 'Nalc' then
+            call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u, 'A0PK', false, false)
+        endif
+        call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateLevel"), ultimateLevel)
+    endif
+    if form == 'N03C' then
+        if ultimateLevel > 0 then
+            call UnitAddAbility(u, 'S008')
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'S008', ultimateLevel)
+            call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(u, true, 'S008')
+            if previous != 'N03C' then
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'A15G')
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'A15H')
+                if GetRandomInt(0, 1) == 0 then
+                    call UnitAddAbility(u, 'A15G')
+                    call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A15G', ultimateLevel)
+                else
+                    call UnitAddAbility(u, 'A15H')
+                    call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A15H', ultimateLevel)
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+    else
+        call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'S008')
+        call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'A15G')
+        call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'A15H')
+    endif
+    set passiveButton = BlzGetUnitAbility(u, 'S008')
+    if passiveButton != null then
+        if BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(passiveButton, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_X) != 3 or BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(passiveButton, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_Y) != 2 then
+            call BlzSetAbilityIntegerField(passiveButton, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_X, 3)
+            call BlzSetAbilityIntegerField(passiveButton, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_Y, 2)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set passiveButton = null
+    call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("form"), form)
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S93_UpdateLearnUI takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i = 1
+    local unit u
+    local boolean hideButton = false
+    // Do not query command frames during map loading or before a hero is selected.
+    if TimerGetElapsed(GS2S_Clock) < 5.00 then
+        return
+    endif
+    // Resolve the built-in frame synchronously on every client, before any
+    // local selection condition. Only its visibility/enabled state is local.
+    if GS2S93_LearnFrame == null then
+        set GS2S93_LearnFrame = BlzGetFrameByName("CommandButton_7", 0)
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 12
+        set u = udg_HeroPlayer[i]
+        if u != null and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'N03C' and IsUnitSelected(u, GetLocalPlayer()) then
+            set hideButton = true
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    if GS2S93_LearnFrame != null then
+        if hideButton then
+            call BlzFrameSetVisible(GS2S93_LearnFrame, false)
+            call BlzFrameSetEnable(GS2S93_LearnFrame, false)
+            set GS2S93_LearnHidden = true
+        elseif GS2S93_LearnHidden then
+            call BlzFrameSetVisible(GS2S93_LearnFrame, true)
+            call BlzFrameSetEnable(GS2S93_LearnFrame, true)
+            set GS2S93_LearnHidden = false
+        endif
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_HeroTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    call ForGroup(GS2S_Heroes, function GS2S_HeroUpdate)
+    call GS2S93_UpdateLearnUI()
+endfunction
+function GS2S_PotionImpact takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit caster = LoadUnitHandle(GS2S_Data, id, 2)
+    local effect bottle = LoadEffectHandle(GS2S_Data, id, 3)
+    local integer ticks = LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 4) + 1
+    local real fraction = I2R(ticks) / I2R(LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 5))
+    local real x = LoadReal(GS2S_Data, id, 6)
+    local real y = LoadReal(GS2S_Data, id, 7)
+    local unit dummy
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectX(bottle, x + (LoadReal(GS2S_Data, id, 8) - x) * fraction)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectY(bottle, y + (LoadReal(GS2S_Data, id, 9) - y) * fraction)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectZ(bottle, 70.00 + 450.00 * fraction * (1.00 - fraction))
+    if fraction >= 1.00 then
+        set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'e002', LoadReal(GS2S_Data, id, 8), LoadReal(GS2S_Data, id, 9), 0.00)
+        call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'A10F')
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'A10F', LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 10))
+        call SetUnitState(dummy, UNIT_STATE_MANA, 1000.00)
+        call IssueImmediateOrder(dummy, "thunderclap")
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 1.00)
+        call DestroyEffect(bottle)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS2S_Data, id)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    else
+        call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 4, ticks)
+    endif
+    set dummy = null
+    set caster = null
+    set bottle = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_PotionLaunch takes unit caster, real x, real y returns nothing
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(t)
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'A052')
+    local integer effectLevel = level
+    local real dx = x - GetUnitX(caster)
+    local real dy = y - GetUnitY(caster)
+    local integer ticks = R2I(SquareRoot(dx*dx + dy*dy) / 30.00) + 1
+    if ticks > 25 then
+        set ticks = 25
+    endif
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'R08Y', true) > 0 and GetRandomInt(1, 100) <= 50 then
+        set effectLevel = level + 8
+    elseif GetRandomInt(0, 1) == 0 then
+        set effectLevel = level + 4
+    endif
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_Data, id, 2, caster)
+    call SaveEffectHandle(GS2S_Data, id, 3, AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\AcidBomb\\BottleMissile.mdl", GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster)))
+    call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 5, ticks)
+    call SaveReal(GS2S_Data, id, 6, GetUnitX(caster))
+    call SaveReal(GS2S_Data, id, 7, GetUnitY(caster))
+    call SaveReal(GS2S_Data, id, 8, x)
+    call SaveReal(GS2S_Data, id, 9, y)
+    call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 10, effectLevel)
+    call TimerStart(t, 0.03, true, function GS2S_PotionImpact)
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_Enter takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit caster
+    local timer t
+    if GS2S_IsHero(u) then
+        call GroupAddUnit(GS2S_Heroes, u)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+    set caster = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_ItemDamageApply takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit source=LoadUnitHandle(GS2S_ItemDamageData,key,0)
+    local unit target=LoadUnitHandle(GS2S_ItemDamageData,key,1)
+    local real amount=LoadReal(GS2S_ItemDamageData,key,2)
+    // Release this cast's storage before entering any nested damage callbacks.
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS2S_ItemDamageData,key)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    if source!=null and target!=null and GetUnitTypeId(source)!=0 and GetUnitTypeId(target)!=0 then
+        call UnitDamageTarget(source,target,amount,false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+    endif
+    set source=null
+    set target=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_ItemBonus takes unit u, unit target, boolean tracked returns nothing
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer level=GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0P7')
+    local timer pending
+    local integer key
+    if target==null or not IsUnitEnemy(target,GetOwningPlayer(u)) or level<=0 then
+        return
+    endif
+    if tracked then
+        if LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemBonusPaid")) then
+            return
+        endif
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemBonusPaid"),true)
+    endif
+    // Every accepted bonus owns its caster, target and damage independently.
+    // Exit native item/spell dispatch before applying this triggered damage.
+    set pending=CreateTimer()
+    set key=GetHandleId(pending)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_ItemDamageData,key,0,u)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_ItemDamageData,key,1,target)
+    call SaveReal(GS2S_ItemDamageData,key,2,10.00+20.00*I2R(level))
+    call TimerStart(pending,0.00,false,function GS2S_ItemDamageApply)
+    set pending=null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_ItemOrder takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer order=GetIssuedOrderId()
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(u)
+    local item it
+    if GS2S_IsHero(u) and order>=852008 and order<=852013 then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItem"))
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItemTarget"))
+        if GetTriggerEventId()==EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_TARGET_ORDER and GetOrderTargetUnit()!=null then
+            set it=UnitItemInSlot(u,order-852008)
+            if it!=null then
+                call SaveItemHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItem"),it)
+                call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItemTarget"),GetOrderTargetUnit())
+                call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemBonusPaid"),false)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set it=null
+    set u=null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_ItemUse takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(u)
+    local item it=GetManipulatedItem()
+    local unit target
+    if GS2S_IsHero(u) and it!=null and it==LoadItemHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItem")) then
+        set target=LoadUnitHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItemTarget"))
+        call GS2S_ItemBonus(u,target,true)
+    endif
+    set target=null
+    set it=null
+    set u=null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_PreCast takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer aid=GetSpellAbilityId()
+    if GS2S_IsHero(u) then
+        call RemoveSavedInteger(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemCastAbility"))
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemCastTarget"))
+        if GetSpellTargetUnit()!=null and GS2S_ItemSpell(u,aid) then
+            call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemCastAbility"),aid)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemCastTarget"),GetSpellTargetUnit())
+        endif
+        if GetSpellAbilityId() == 'A052' then
+            call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_Data, GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u)), StringHash("potionCaster"), u)
+        elseif GetSpellAbilityId() == 'A0QM' then
+            call GS2S_RestoreLevels(u)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_Learn takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer level
+    local integer before
+    local integer learned = GetLearnedSkill()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'N03C' then
+        set before = GetLearnedSkillLevel() - 1
+        if before > 0 then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u, learned, before)
+        else
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u, learned)
+        endif
+        call UnitModifySkillPoints(u, 1)
+        set u = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if GS2S_IsHero(u) then
+        call GroupAddUnit(GS2S_Heroes, u)
+        if GetLearnedSkill() == 'S008' then
+            call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 'A0PK', GetLearnedSkillLevel())
+        elseif GetLearnedSkill() == 'A0PK' then
+            call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 'A0PK', GetLearnedSkillLevel())
+        endif
+        if GetLearnedSkill() == 'A0P7' then
+            set level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0P7')
+            set before = LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("researchLearn"))
+            if level > before then
+                call SetHeroInt(u, GetHeroInt(u, false) + 3 * (level - before), true)
+                if before < 3 and level >= 3 then
+                    call AdjustPlayerStateBJ(300, GetOwningPlayer(u), PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD)
+                endif
+                if before < 4 and level >= 4 then
+                    call AdjustPlayerStateBJ(1, GetOwningPlayer(u), PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER)
+                endif
+                call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("researchLearn"), level)
+            endif
+        endif
+        call GS2S_RestoreLevels(u)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local integer abilityId = GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local integer level
+    local unit dummy
+    local real cooldown
+    if not GS2S_IsHero(u) then
+        set u = null
+        set target = null
+        return
+    endif
+    call GroupAddUnit(GS2S_Heroes, u)
+    if abilityId == 'A052' then
+        call GS2S_PotionLaunch(u, GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY())
+    elseif abilityId == 'A0PW' and target != null and IsUnitEnemy(target, GetOwningPlayer(u)) then
+        set level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0PW')
+        set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(u), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target), 0.00)
+        call SetUnitState(dummy, UNIT_STATE_MANA, 1000.00)
+        if GetRandomInt(1, 100) <= 50 then
+            call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'A11D')
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'A11D', level)
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ(dummy, "curse", target)
+        else
+            call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'A12K')
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'A12K', level)
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ(dummy, "soulburn", target)
+        endif
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 2.00)
+    elseif abilityId == 'A0PK' and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'Nalc' then
+        set level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0PK')
+        if level == 1 then
+            set cooldown = 80.00
+        elseif level == 2 then
+            set cooldown = 55.00
+        else
+            set cooldown = 30.00
+        endif
+        call GS117_ResetUnitCooldowns(u)
+        call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u, 'A0PK', cooldown)
+    elseif target != null and IsUnitEnemy(target, GetOwningPlayer(u)) and (GS2S_ItemSpell(u, abilityId) or (LoadInteger(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("itemCastAbility"))==abilityId and LoadUnitHandle(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("itemCastTarget"))==target)) then
+        call GS2S_ItemBonus(u,target,LoadItemHandle(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("orderedItem"))!=null and LoadUnitHandle(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("orderedItemTarget"))==target)
+    endif
+    call RemoveSavedInteger(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("itemCastAbility"))
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("itemCastTarget"))
+    set dummy = null
+    set target = null
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_Research takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit shop = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local player p = GetOwningPlayer(shop)
+    local integer tech = GetResearched()
+    local unit hero = udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(p)]
+    if GetUnitTypeId(shop) != 'n02U' or not GS2S_IsHero(hero) then
+        set shop = null
+        set hero = null
+        set p = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if tech == 'R07T' then
+        call AdjustPlayerStateBJ(1200, p, PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD)
+    elseif tech == 'R07U' then
+        call UnitAddItemById(hero, 'I06T')
+    elseif tech == 'R07V' then
+        call UnitAddItemById(hero, 'I00P')
+    elseif tech == 'R07W' then
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, GetHandleId(hero), StringHash("rageUnlocked"), true)
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, GetHandleId(hero), StringHash("rageEnabled"), true)
+        call UnitAddAbility(hero, 'A0QM')
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(hero, true, 'A0QM')
+        call BlzUnitDisableAbility(hero, 'A0QM', false, false)
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(hero, 'A0QM', false)
+    endif
+    set shop = null
+    set hero = null
+    set p = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t = CreateTrigger()
+    local timer poll = CreateTimer()
+    set GS2S_Clock = CreateTimer()
+    call TimerStart(GS2S_Clock, 10000000.00, false, null)
+    set GS2S_Data = InitHashtable()
+    set GS2S_ItemDamageData = InitHashtable()
+    call GS2S_InitItemData()
+    set GS2S_Heroes = CreateGroup()
+    call TriggerRegisterEnterRectSimple(t, GetPlayableMapRect())
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2S_Enter)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_CAST)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2S_PreCast)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_TARGET_ORDER)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2S_ItemOrder)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_POINT_ORDER)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2S_ItemOrder)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_ORDER)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2S_ItemOrder)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_USE_ITEM)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2S_ItemUse)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2S_Spell)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_SKILL)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2S_Learn)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESEARCH_FINISH)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2S_Research)
+    call TimerStart(poll, 0.10, true, function GS2S_HeroTick)
+    set t = null
+    set poll = null
+endfunction
+// GS2 Talent Tooltip Runtime - GUTS FINAL FIX
+function GS2TT_Append takes player p, integer abilId, integer maxLevel, string talentName, string effectText, boolean showEffect returns nothing
+    local integer i = 0
+    local string oldText
+    local string addText
+    if GetLocalPlayer() == p then
+        if showEffect and StringLength(effectText) > 0 then
+            set addText = "|n|n|cff80ff80[특성 적용] " + talentName + "|r|n" + effectText
+        else
+            set addText = "|n|n|cff80ff80[특성 적용] " + talentName + "|r"
+        endif
+        loop
+            exitwhen i >= maxLevel
+            set oldText = BlzGetAbilityExtendedTooltip(abilId, i)
+            call BlzSetAbilityExtendedTooltip(abilId, oldText + addText, i)
+            set i = i + 1
+        endloop
+    endif
+endfunction

+function GS294_BurnTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i = 1
+    local integer level
+    local unit source
+    local unit target
+    local real remaining
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 12
+        set source = udg_HeroPlayer[i]
+        if source != null and GetUnitTypeId(source) == 'Odrt' and GetWidgetLife(source) > 0.405 and not IsUnitIllusion(source) and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(source), 'R04B', true) > 0 then
+            set level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(source, 'ANic')
+            if level >= 1 and level <= 4 then
+                if GetUnitAbilityLevel(source, 'A0UG') == 0 then
+                    call UnitAddAbility(source, 'A0UG')
+                endif
+                call SetUnitAbilityLevel(source, 'A0UG', level)
+                call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(GS294_BurnTargets, GetUnitX(source), GetUnitY(source), 250.00, null)
+                loop
+                    set target = FirstOfGroup(GS294_BurnTargets)
+                    exitwhen target == null
+                    call GroupRemoveUnit(GS294_BurnTargets, target)
+                    if IsUnitEnemy(target, GetOwningPlayer(source)) and GetWidgetLife(target) > 0.405 and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(target) then
+                        set remaining = GetUnitState(target, UNIT_STATE_MANA) - (2.00 + 2.00 * I2R(level))
+                        if remaining < 0.00 then
+                            set remaining = 0.00
+                        endif
+                        call SetUnitState(target, UNIT_STATE_MANA, remaining)
+                    endif
+                endloop
+            endif
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    set source = null
+    set target = null
+endfunction
+function GS294_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer clock = CreateTimer()
+    set GS294_BurnTargets = CreateGroup()
+    call TimerStart(clock, 1.00, true, function GS294_BurnTick)
+    set clock = null
+endfunction
+function GS296_PandoraClap takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit target
+    local group targets
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'A0O3')
+    if GetSpellAbilityId() != 'A0O3' or level < 1 or level > 3 then
+        set caster = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set targets = CreateGroup()
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(targets, GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster), 542.00, null)
+    loop
+        set target = FirstOfGroup(targets)
+        exitwhen target == null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(targets, target)
+        if IsUnitInRange(target, caster, 350.00) and IsUnitEnemy(target, GetOwningPlayer(caster)) and GetWidgetLife(target) > 0.405 and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_FLYING) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(target) then
+            call UnitDamageTarget(caster, target, 150.00, false, false, ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+        endif
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(targets)
+    set targets = null
+    set target = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+    local trigger clap = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(clap, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT)

+    set clap = null
+endfunction
+// Dragon Warrior restoration from gs2v155i. All object IDs are isolated.
+function GS2DW_Valid takes unit target, unit caster, boolean groundOnly returns boolean
+    return target != null and GetWidgetLife(target) > 0.405 and IsUnitEnemy(target, GetOwningPlayer(caster)) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(target) and (not groundOnly or not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_FLYING))

+function GS2DW_Dummy takes unit caster, unit target, integer skill, integer level, integer order returns nothing

+    call UnitAddAbility(dummy, skill)
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, skill, level)
+    call IssueTargetOrderById(dummy, order, target)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 2.0)
+    set dummy = null
+endfunction
+function GS2DW_UpdateQ takes unit hero returns nothing

+            set level = level + 4
+        endif
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(hero, 'ADq2', level)
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(hero, true, 'ADq2')
+    endif
+endfunction

+function GS2DW_Learn takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetUnitTypeId(GetTriggerUnit()) == 'HDr1' and GetLearnedSkill() == 'ADq1' then
+        call GS2DW_UpdateQ(GetTriggerUnit())
+    endif
+    if GetUnitTypeId(GetTriggerUnit())=='HDr1' and GetLearnedSkill()=='ADe1' and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),'RD04',true)>0 then
+        call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(BlzGetUnitAbility(GetTriggerUnit(),'ADe1'),ABILITY_RLF_AREA_OF_EFFECT,GetUnitAbilityLevel(GetTriggerUnit(),'ADe1')-1,300.0)
+        call GS16_EText(GetTriggerUnit())
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS2DW_Research takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer rank=0
+    local player p=GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())
+    local integer tech=GetResearched()
+    local unit h=udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))+1]
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='HDr1' and GetResearched()=='RD03' then
+        call GS2DW_UpdateQ(h)
+    endif
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='HDr1' and GetResearched()=='RD04' and GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ADe1')>0 then
+        loop
+            exitwhen rank>=4
+            call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(BlzGetUnitAbility(h,'ADe1'),ABILITY_RLF_AREA_OF_EFFECT,rank,300.0)
+            set rank=rank+1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='HDr1' then
+        if tech=='RD03' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(p,'ADq2',8,"강력한 한기","사거리 725, 감속 2.5초.",true)
+        elseif tech=='RD02' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(p,'ADw1',4,"영혼 빙결","주변 범위 300 안의 적을 2초간 침묵시킵니다.",true)
+        elseif tech=='RD04' then
+            call GS16_EText(h)
+        elseif tech=='RD05' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(p,'ADr1',3,"얼음의 축복","빙결 뒤 1초간 이동속도 20% 감소.",true)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set p=null
+    set h=null
+endfunction
+// Global effect lifecycle; no gameplay orders or damage are added here.
+function GS120_BreathVisualTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer key = GetHandleId(t)
+    local effect e = LoadEffectHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,11)
+    local real distance = LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,12)+LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,15)*0.03125
+    local real x
+    local real y
+    if distance > 1000.0 then
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(e,0.0)
+        call DestroyEffect(e)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS2DW_Data,key)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    else
+        set x = LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,13)+distance*Cos(LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,16))
+        set y = LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,14)+distance*Sin(LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,16))
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectX(e,x)
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectY(e,y)
+        call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,12,distance)
+    endif
+    set e = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+function GS120_BreathVisual takes unit source, real x, real y returns nothing
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    local integer key = GetHandleId(t)
+    local real angle = Atan2(y-GetUnitY(source),x-GetUnitX(source))
+    local effect e = AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\CrushingWave\\CrushingWaveMissile.mdl",GetUnitX(source),GetUnitY(source))
+    local integer speed = BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(BlzGetUnitAbility(source,'ADr2'),ABILITY_IF_MISSILE_SPEED)
+    if speed <= 0 then
+        set speed = 1100
+    endif
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectYaw(e,angle)
+    call SaveEffectHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,11,e)
+    call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,12,0.0)
+    call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,13,GetUnitX(source))
+    call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,14,GetUnitY(source))
+    call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,15,I2R(speed))
+    call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,16,angle)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.03125,true,function GS120_BreathVisualTick)
+    set t = null
+    set e = null
+endfunction

+function GS120_BreathLimit takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit source = GetEventDamageSource()
+    local unit target = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local real dx
+    local real dy
+    if GetUnitTypeId(source) == 'dDr1' then
+        set dx = GetUnitX(target)-GetUnitX(source)
+        set dy = GetUnitY(target)-GetUnitY(source)
+        if dx*dx+dy*dy > 1000000.0 then
+            call BlzSetEventDamage(0.0)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set source = null
+    set target = null
+endfunction

+function DWT_Mana takes unit h, unit v returns nothing
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h) == 'HDr1' and IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_HERO) and not IsUnitIllusion(v) and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD01',true)>0 and now>=LoadReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),90) then
+        call SaveReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),90,now+10.0)
+        call SetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA,RMinBJ(GetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA),GetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA)+30.0))
+    endif
+endfunction
+function DWT_Slow takes unit h, unit v, integer lv, real strength, real duration returns nothing
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(v)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)
+    local unit d
+    local integer skill='DXsl'
+    if not GS2DW_Valid(v,h,false) then
+        return
+    endif
+    if LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,81)>now and LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,80)>strength then
+        return
+    endif
+    if LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,81)>now and LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,80)==strength and LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,81)>=now+duration then
+        return
+    endif
+    call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,80,strength)
+    call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,81,now+duration)
+    if lv==9 or lv==11 then
+        set skill='DXls'
+    endif
+    set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(v),GetUnitY(v),0.0)
+    call UnitAddAbility(d,skill)
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,skill,lv)
+    call SetUnitState(d,UNIT_STATE_MANA,1000.0)
+    call IssueTargetOrder(d,"slow",v)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',1.0)
+    set d=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_Area takes unit h, real x, real y, real radius, real damage, integer sl, real strength, real duration returns nothing
+    local group g=CreateGroup()
+    local unit v
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(g,x,y,radius+192.0,null)
+    loop
+        set v=FirstOfGroup(g)
+        exitwhen v==null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(g,v)
+        if IsUnitInRangeXY(v,x,y,radius) and GS2DW_Valid(v,h,false) then
+            if damage>0.0 then
+                set DWT_Dealt=false
+                call UnitDamageTarget(h,v,damage,false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+                if DWT_Dealt then
+                    call DWT_Mana(h,v)
+                endif
+            endif
+            call DWT_Slow(h,v,sl,strength,duration)
+        endif
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(g)
+    set g=null
+    set v=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_ZoneEnd takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local integer i=10
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>21
+        call DestroyEffect(LoadEffectHandle(DWT_Data,k,i))
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    call DestroyEffect(LoadEffectHandle(DWT_Data,k,6))
+    call FlushChildHashtable(DWT_Data,k)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_LightEnd takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local effect e=LoadEffectHandle(DWT_Data,k,95)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(e,0.0)
+    call DestroyEffect(e)
+    call FlushChildHashtable(DWT_Data,k)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set e=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_LightBurst takes real x, real y, real radius returns nothing
+    local timer t=CreateTimer()
+    local effect e=AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\FrostNova\\FrostNovaTarget.mdl",x,y)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(e,radius/150.0)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(e,140)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectColor(e,170,200,230)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectTimeScale(e,1.30)
+    call SaveEffectHandle(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(t),95,e)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.55,false,function DWT_LightEnd)
+    set e=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_WPop takes unit h returns nothing
+    local timer t=CreateTimer()
+    local effect e=AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\FrostNova\\FrostNovaTarget.mdl",GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h))
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(e,0.65)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(e,210)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectColor(e,170,200,230)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectTimeScale(e,1.80)
+    call SaveEffectHandle(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(t),95,e)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.40,false,function DWT_LightEnd)
+    set e=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_ZoneStep takes timer t returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local integer tick=LoadInteger(DWT_Data,k,1)+1
+    local unit h=LoadUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,0)
+    local real damage=0.0
+    if tick<=4 or (tick==5 and LoadBoolean(DWT_Data,k,7)) then
+        set damage=LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,4)
+    endif
+    if damage>0.0 then
+        call DWT_LightBurst(LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,2),LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,3),LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,5))
+    endif
+    call DWT_Area(h,LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,2),LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,3),LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,5),damage,11,0.20,0.65)
+    call SaveInteger(DWT_Data,k,1,tick)
+    if tick>=5 then
+        call TimerStart(t,0.60,false,function DWT_ZoneEnd)
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_ZoneTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    call DWT_ZoneStep(GetExpiredTimer())
+endfunction
+function DWT_BreathSlow takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=LoadUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,0)
+    local unit v=LoadUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,1)
+    call DWT_Slow(h,v,12,0.20,1.0)
+    call FlushChildHashtable(DWT_Data,k)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_WEnd takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=LoadUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,0)
+    if h!=null and LoadTimerHandle(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),72)==t then
+        call UnitRemoveAbility(h,'DXwb')
+        call RemoveSavedReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),70)
+        call RemoveSavedReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),71)
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),72)
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(DWT_Data,k)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set h=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS2DW_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer aid=GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local integer lv=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,aid)
+    local real duration=1.0
+    local real radius=225.0
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    local integer i
+    local real angle
+    local unit d
+    local real x=GetSpellTargetX()
+    local real y=GetSpellTargetY()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='HDr1' then
+        if aid=='ADw1' then
+            set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),0.0)
+            call UnitAddAbility(d,'DXwa')
+            call SetUnitState(d,UNIT_STATE_MANA,1000.0)
+            call IssueTargetOrder(d,"frostarmor",h)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',1.0)
+            call DWT_LightBurst(GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),300.0)
+            call DWT_WPop(h)
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),70,TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)+3.0)
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),71,0.04+0.04*I2R(lv))
+            set t=CreateTimer()
+            call SaveUnitHandle(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(t),0,h)
+            call SaveTimerHandle(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),72,t)
+            call TimerStart(t,3.0,false,function DWT_WEnd)
+            call DWT_Area(h,GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),300.0,50.0*I2R(lv),9,0.30,1.0)
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD02',true)>0 then
+                set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),0.0)
+                call UnitAddAbility(d,'DXsi')
+                call SetUnitState(d,UNIT_STATE_MANA,1000.0)
+                call IssuePointOrder(d,"silence",GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h))
+                call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',1.0)
+            endif
+        elseif aid=='ADe1' then
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD04',true)>0 then
+                set radius=300.0
+            endif
+            set t=CreateTimer()
+            set k=GetHandleId(t)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,0,h)
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,2,x)
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,3,y)
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,4,15.0+15.0*I2R(lv))
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,5,radius)
+            call SaveBoolean(DWT_Data,k,7,GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD04',true)>0)
+            call DWT_ZoneStep(t)
+            call TimerStart(t,0.6,true,function DWT_ZoneTick)
+        elseif aid=='ADr1' then
+            set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'dDr1',GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),Atan2(y-GetUnitY(h),x-GetUnitX(h))*bj_RADTODEG)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(GS2DW_Data,GetHandleId(d),0,h)
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,'ADr2',lv)
+            call SetUnitVertexColor(d,255,255,255,128)
+            call IssuePointOrder(d,"shockwave",x,y)
+            call GS120_BreathVisual(d,x,y)
+            call TriggerSleepAction(0.50)
+            call SetUnitScale(d,0.0,0.0,0.0)
+            call TriggerSleepAction(2.0)
+            call FlushChildHashtable(GS2DW_Data,GetHandleId(d))
+            call RemoveUnit(d)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set d=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS107_QHit takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetEventDamageSource()
+    local unit v=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer lv=LoadInteger(GS107_Data,GetHandleId(h),11)
+    local integer serial=LoadInteger(GS107_Data,GetHandleId(h),12)
+    local integer slowlevel=lv
+    local real duration=2.0
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='HDr1' and not BlzGetEventIsAttack() and lv>0 and TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)<=LoadReal(GS107_Data,GetHandleId(h),10) and RAbsBJ(GetEventDamage()-(10.0+80.0*I2R(lv)+0.03125))<0.001 and LoadInteger(GS107_Hits,GetHandleId(h),GetHandleId(v))!=serial then
+        call BlzSetEventDamage(10.0+80.0*I2R(lv))
+        call SaveInteger(GS107_Hits,GetHandleId(h),GetHandleId(v),serial)
+        call SaveReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),GetHandleId(v),TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)+0.10)
+        if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD03',true)>0 then
+            set slowlevel=lv+4
+            set duration=2.5
+        endif
+        call DWT_Slow(h,v,slowlevel,0.15+0.05*I2R(lv),duration)
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+endfunction
+function GS2DW_Damage takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit s=GetEventDamageSource()
+    local unit v=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit h
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    if GetEventDamage()>0.0 then
+        set DWT_Dealt=true
+        if GetUnitTypeId(s)=='dDr1' then
+            set h=LoadUnitHandle(GS2DW_Data,GetHandleId(s),0)
+            if h!=null and GS2DW_Valid(v,h,true) and not LoadBoolean(GS2DW_Data,GetHandleId(s),GetHandleId(v)) then
+                call SaveBoolean(GS2DW_Data,GetHandleId(s),GetHandleId(v),true)
+                call GS2DW_Dummy(h,v,'ADf1',1,852095)
+                call DWT_Mana(h,v)
+                if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD05',true)>0 then
+                    set t=CreateTimer()
+                    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+                    call SaveUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,0,h)
+                    call SaveUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,1,v)
+                    call TimerStart(t,1.0,false,function DWT_BreathSlow)
+                endif
+            endif
+        elseif GetUnitTypeId(s)=='HDr1' and not BlzGetEventIsAttack() and LoadReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(s),GetHandleId(v))>=TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime) then
+            call RemoveSavedReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(s),GetHandleId(v))
+            call DWT_Mana(s,v)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set s=null
+    set v=null
+    set h=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_Reduce takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit v=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer ty=GetUnitTypeId(v)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(GetEventDamageSource())=='uSa1' and (ty=='o000' or ty=='o00S' or ty=='oeye') then
+        call BlzSetEventDamage(0.0)
+    endif
+    if GetUnitTypeId(v)=='HDr1' and LoadReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(v),70)>TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime) and GetUnitAbilityLevel(v,'DXwb')>0 and GetEventDamage()>0.0 then
+        call BlzSetEventDamage(GetEventDamage()*(1.0-LoadReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(v),71)))
+    endif
+    set v=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t=CreateTrigger()
+    local integer i=0
+    set DWT_Data=InitHashtable()
+
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(t,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGING,null)
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function DWT_Reduce)
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS108_FrostText takes unit u returns nothing
+    local texttag tag = CreateTextTag()
+    call SetTextTagText(tag, "동상", 0.020)
+    call SetTextTagPosUnit(tag, u, 35.0)
+    call SetTextTagColor(tag, 120, 210, 255, 220)
+    call SetTextTagVelocity(tag, 0.0, 0.035)
+    call SetTextTagPermanent(tag, false)
+    call SetTextTagLifespan(tag, 0.85)
+    call SetTextTagFadepoint(tag, 0.50)
+    call SetTextTagVisibility(tag, IsUnitVisible(u, GetLocalPlayer()))
+    set tag = null
+endfunction
+function GS107_DotTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit source = LoadUnitHandle(GS107_Data, id, 0)
+    local unit target = LoadUnitHandle(GS107_Data, id, 1)
+    local integer count = LoadInteger(GS107_Data, id, 3)
+    local boolean seen = LoadBoolean(GS107_Data, id, 4)
+    local boolean stop = GetUnitTypeId(source) == 0 or GetWidgetLife(target) <= 0.405 or IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE)
+    if GetUnitAbilityLevel(target, 'BDq1') > 0 then
+        set seen = true
+        call SaveBoolean(GS107_Data, id, 4, true)
+    elseif seen and count < 4 then
+        set stop = true
+    endif
+    if not stop then
+        call UnitDamageTarget(source, target, 5.0 + 5.0 * I2R(LoadInteger(GS107_Data, id, 2)), false, false, ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+        call GS108_FrostText(target)
+        set count = count + 1
+        call SaveInteger(GS107_Data, id, 3, count)
+    endif
+    if stop or count >= 5 then
+        if LoadReal(GS107_Data, GetHandleId(target), 101) == LoadReal(GS107_Data, id, 6) then
+            call RemoveSavedReal(GS107_Data, GetHandleId(target), 101)
+        endif
+        call DestroyEffect(LoadEffectHandle(GS107_Data, id, 5))
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS107_Timers, GetHandleId(target), GetHandleId(source))
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS107_Data, id)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    set source = null
+    set target = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+function GS107_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer sid = GetHandleId(caster)
+    local integer level
+    local group g
+    local unit u
+    if GetSpellAbilityId() == 'ADq2' and GetUnitTypeId(caster) == 'HDr1' then
+        set level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'ADq2')
+        if level > 4 then
+            set level = level - 4
+        endif
+        call SaveReal(GS107_Data, sid, 10, TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime) + 2.0)
+        call SaveInteger(GS107_Data, sid, 11, level)
+        call SaveInteger(GS107_Data, sid, 12, LoadInteger(GS107_Data, sid, 12) + 1)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS107_Hits, sid)
+    elseif GetSpellAbilityId() == 'A0PT' then
+        set g = CreateGroup()
+        call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(g, GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY(), 400.0, null)
+        loop
+            set u = FirstOfGroup(g)
+            exitwhen u == null
+            call GroupRemoveUnit(g, u)
+            if GetWidgetLife(u) > 0.405 and IsUnitEnemy(u, GetOwningPlayer(caster)) and not IsUnitType(u, UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(u) then
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'Bams')
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'Bam2')
+            endif
+        endloop
+        call DestroyGroup(g)
+    endif
+    set g = null
+    set u = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+        set i = i + 1

+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS107_QHit)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS107_Spell)
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+// Runtime callbacks
+function GS2FB_Area takes unit caster, real radius, real damage returns nothing
+    local group targets = CreateGroup()
+    local unit target
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(targets, GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster), radius + 192.0, null)
+    loop
+        set target = FirstOfGroup(targets)
+        exitwhen target == null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(targets, target)
+        if IsUnitInRange(target, caster, radius) and GS2DW_Valid(target, caster, true) then
+            call UnitDamageTarget(caster, target, damage, false, false, ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+        endif
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(targets)
+    set targets = null
+    set target = null
+endfunction
+function GS2FB_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local unit dummy
+    local integer skill = GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, skill)
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(caster)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(caster) == 'OFl1' then
+        if skill == 'AFq1' then
+            call GS2FB_Area(caster, 350.0, 40.0 + 80.0 * I2R(level))
+        elseif skill == 'AFw1' and target != null then
+            set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster), 0.0)
+            call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'AFw2')
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'RF03', true) > 0 then
+                set level = level + 4
+            endif
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'AFw2', level)
+            call IssuePointOrderById(dummy, 852488, GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target))
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 8.0)
+        elseif skill == 'AFr1' then
+            call SaveReal(GS2FB_Data, id, 0, TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime) + 2.0 + 0.50 * I2R(level))
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'RF04', true) > 0 then
+                call GS2DW_Dummy(caster, caster, 'AFt2', 1, 852186)
+            endif
+            call PlaySoundBJ(gg_snd_ThL_Ulti)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set caster = null
+    set target = null
+    set dummy = null
+endfunction
+function GS2FB_End takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetUnitTypeId(GetTriggerUnit()) == 'OFl1' and GetSpellAbilityId() == 'AFr1' then
+        call RemoveSavedReal(GS2FB_Data, GetHandleId(GetTriggerUnit()), 0)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS2FB_Damaged takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit hero = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit dummy
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(hero, 'AFe1')
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(hero)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(hero) == 'OFl1' and GetEventDamage() > 0.0 and BlzGetEventIsAttack() and level > 0 and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(hero), 'RF02', true) > 0 and now >= LoadReal(GS2FB_Data, id, 1) then
+        if GetRandomInt(1,100) <= 12 then
+            call SaveReal(GS2FB_Data, id, 1, now + 4.0)
+            set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(hero), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(hero), GetUnitY(hero), 0.0)
+            call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'AFt1')
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'AFt1', level)
+            call IssueImmediateOrder(dummy, "thunderclap")
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 1.0)
+            call GS2FB_Area(hero, 325.0, 80.0 + 20.0 * I2R(level))
+            call TextTag("야수의 분노!", hero, 10, 255, 255, 150, 3)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set hero = null
+    set dummy = null
+endfunction
+function GS2FB_Reduce takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit hero = GetTriggerUnit()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(hero) == 'OFl1' and LoadReal(GS2FB_Data, GetHandleId(hero), 0) > TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime) and GetEventDamage() > 0.0 then
+        call BlzSetEventDamage(GetEventDamage() * 0.67)
+    endif
+    set hero = null
+endfunction

+    endif

+    local player owner = GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())

+        elseif tech == 'RF04' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(owner, 'AFr1', 3, "집념의 포식자", "시전 시 5초 동안 마법 면역.", true)
+        elseif tech == 'RF02' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(owner, 'AFe1', 4, "야수의 분노", "피격 시 12% 확률로 325 범위에 100/120/140/160 화염 피해 및 1초 기절. 재발동 대기 4초.", true)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set owner = null
+    set hero = null
+endfunction
+function GS2FB_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t = CreateTrigger()
+    local integer i = 0
+    set GS2FB_Data = InitHashtable()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2FB_Spell)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()

+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2FB_End)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()

+        exitwhen i >= bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(t,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGED,null)
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2FB_Damaged)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()

+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(t,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGING,null)
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2FB_Reduce)
+
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESEARCH_FINISH)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2FB_Research)
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+// A per-cast deadline avoids restarting a full Wind Walk cooldown when invisibility ends.
+function GS117_WindBuff takes integer aid returns integer
+    if aid == 'A0G4' then
+        return 'B0AC'
+    elseif aid == 'A09P' then
+        return 'B02D'
+    elseif aid == 'A0AK' then
+        return 'B02O'
+    elseif aid == 'A02B' then
+        return 'B011'
+    elseif aid == 'A0HX' then
+        return 'B04Z'
+    elseif aid == 'A0BW' then
+        return 'B05F'
+    elseif aid == 'A0EA' then
+        return 'B0AP'
+    endif
+    if aid == 'A0PE' then
+        return 'BOwk'
+    endif
+    return 0
+endfunction
+function GS125_WindProxy takes integer aid returns integer
+    if aid == 'A0G4' then
+        return 'ZW51'
+    elseif aid == 'A0AK' then
+        return 'ZW52'
+    elseif aid == 'A09P' then
+        return 'ZW53'
+    elseif aid == 'A02B' then
+        return 'ZW54'
+    elseif aid == 'A0BW' then
+        return 'ZW55'
+    elseif aid == 'A0HX' then
+        return 'ZW56'
+    endif
+    if aid == 'A0EA' then
+        return 'ZW58'
+    endif
+    if aid == 'A0PE' then
+        return 'ZW57'
+    endif
+    return 0
+endfunction
+function GS117_WindTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit u = LoadUnitHandle(GS117_Data, k, 0)
+    local integer aid = LoadInteger(GS117_Data, k, 1)
+    local integer buff = GS117_WindBuff(aid)
+    local integer proxy = GS125_WindProxy(aid)
+    local real proxyRemaining
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(GS117_Clock)
+    local real elapsed = now - LoadReal(GS117_Data, k, 3)
+    local real remaining = RMaxBJ(0.0, LoadReal(GS117_Data, k, 2) - now)
+    local real actual
+    local integer ended = LoadInteger(GS117_Data, k, 5)
+    local boolean first = not LoadBoolean(GS117_Data, k, 7)
+    local boolean done = false
+    if u == null or GetUnitTypeId(u) == 0 or LoadTimerHandle(GS117_Data, GetHandleId(u), aid) != t then
+        set done = true
+    else
+        if proxy == 0 then
+            call BlzUnitHideAbility(u,aid,false)
+        endif
+        set actual = BlzGetUnitAbilityCooldownRemaining(u, aid)
+        if first then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS117_Data, k, 7, true)
+            if proxy != 0 then
+                call UnitAddAbility(u,proxy)
+                call BlzSetAbilityIntegerField(BlzGetUnitAbility(u,proxy),ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_X,BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(BlzGetUnitAbility(u,aid),ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_X))
+                call BlzSetAbilityIntegerField(BlzGetUnitAbility(u,proxy),ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_Y,BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(BlzGetUnitAbility(u,aid),ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_Y))
+                call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,proxy,GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,aid))
+                call BlzUnitHideAbility(u,aid,true)
+                call BlzUnitHideAbility(u,proxy,false)
+                call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u,proxy,remaining)
+                if remaining <= 0.0 then
+                    call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u,proxy,true,false)
+                endif
+            endif
+            call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u, aid, remaining)
+            call TimerStart(t, 0.10, true, function GS117_WindTick)
+        elseif RAbsBJ(actual - remaining) > 0.25 then
+            // Native Wind Walk can start its full cooldown at the break attack; keep the original deadline.
+            if remaining > 0.0 then
+                call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u, aid, remaining)
+            else
+                call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(u, aid)
+            endif
+        endif
+        if proxy != 0 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,proxy) > 0 then
+            set proxyRemaining = BlzGetUnitAbilityCooldownRemaining(u,proxy)
+            if RAbsBJ(proxyRemaining-remaining) > 0.25 then
+                if remaining > 0.0 then
+                    call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u,proxy,remaining)
+                else
+                    call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(u,proxy)
+                endif
+            endif
+            // An unexpected extended invisibility must not turn the display into a castable skill.
+            if remaining <= 0.0 then
+                call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u,proxy,true,false)
+            endif
+        endif
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, buff) > 0 then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS117_Data, k, 4, true)
+            set ended = 0
+        elseif LoadBoolean(GS117_Data, k, 4) or elapsed >= 2.0 then
+            set ended = ended + 1
+            if ended >= 4 then
+                set done = true
+            endif
+        endif
+        call SaveInteger(GS117_Data, k, 5, ended)
+        if elapsed > LoadReal(GS117_Data, k, 6) then
+            set done = true
+        endif
+    endif
+    if done then
+        if u != null and LoadTimerHandle(GS117_Data, GetHandleId(u), aid) == t then
+            if proxy != 0 then
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,proxy)
+                call BlzUnitHideAbility(u,aid,false)
+                if remaining > 0.0 then
+                    call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u,aid,remaining)
+                else
+                    call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(u,aid)
+                endif
+            endif
+            call RemoveSavedHandle(GS117_Data, GetHandleId(u), aid)
+        endif
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS117_Data, k)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS123_WindUI takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit u = LoadUnitHandle(GS117_Data,k,0)
+    local integer aid = LoadInteger(GS117_Data,k,1)
+    if u != null and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,aid) > 0 and (GS125_WindProxy(aid) == 0 or GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,GS125_WindProxy(aid)) == 0) then
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(u,aid,false)
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS117_Data,k)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set u = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS117_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer aid = GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local integer lv = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, aid)
+    local unit d = null
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    local real cd
+    local real duration
+    local real now
+    if aid == 'A03F' then
+        set lv = IMaxBJ(1, IMinBJ(4, lv))
+        set d = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(u), 'e002', GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY(), 0.0)
+        call UnitAddAbility(d, 'AZ71' + lv - 1)
+        call SetUnitState(d, UNIT_STATE_MANA, 1000.0)
+        call IssuePointOrder(d, "silence", GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY())
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(d, 'BTLF', 2.0)
+    endif
+    if GS117_WindBuff(aid) != 0 and aid != 'A0G4' then
+        set t = CreateTimer()
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS117_Data,GetHandleId(t),0,u)
+        call SaveInteger(GS117_Data,GetHandleId(t),1,aid)
+        call TimerStart(t,0.0,false,function GS123_WindUI)
+    endif
+    if GS117_WindBuff(aid) != 0 and (IsUnitType(u, UNIT_TYPE_HERO) or (aid == 'A0PE' and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'n01U')) and not IsUnitIllusion(u) and (not IsTriggerEnabled(gg_trg_Single_WTFEffect) or GS125_WindProxy(aid) != 0) then
+        set cd = BlzGetUnitAbilityCooldown(u, aid, lv - 1)
+        if IsTriggerEnabled(gg_trg_Single_WTFEffect) then
+            set cd = 0.0
+        endif
+        if cd > 0.0 or GS125_WindProxy(aid) != 0 then
+            set now = TimerGetElapsed(GS117_Clock)
+            set duration = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(BlzGetUnitAbility(u, aid), ABILITY_RLF_DURATION_NORMAL, lv - 1)
+            set t = CreateTimer()
+            set k = GetHandleId(t)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(GS117_Data, k, 0, u)
+            call SaveInteger(GS117_Data, k, 1, aid)
+            call SaveReal(GS117_Data, k, 2, now + cd)
+            call SaveReal(GS117_Data, k, 3, now)
+            call SaveReal(GS117_Data, k, 6, RMaxBJ(cd, duration) + 4.0)
+            call SaveTimerHandle(GS117_Data, GetHandleId(u), aid, t)
+            // Let the successful native cast finish before starting its countdown.
+            call TimerStart(t, 0.0, false, function GS117_WindTick)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set t = null
+    set d = null
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS117_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger spell = CreateTrigger()
+    local integer i = 0
+    set GS117_Data = InitHashtable()
+    set GS117_Clock = CreateTimer()
+    call TimerStart(GS117_Clock, 1000000000.0, false, null)
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(spell, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT, null)
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(spell, function GS117_Spell)
+    set spell = null
+endfunction

+// Sashint restoration test. Hero, skills, buffs and research IDs are isolated.
+function GS144_BootFinish takes timer t, unit u returns nothing
+    local integer key = GetHandleId(t)
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    if u != null and LoadTimerHandle(GS144_Data,uid,2) == t then
+        if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5) then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'SW44')
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'BW45')
+        endif
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS144_Data,uid)
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS144_Data,key)
+    call PauseTimer(t)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+endfunction
+
+function GS144_BootTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local unit u = LoadUnitHandle(GS144_Data,GetHandleId(t),0)
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(GS144_Clock)
+    local boolean ended = false
+    if u == null or GetUnitTypeId(u) == 0 or GetWidgetLife(u) <= 0.405 or LoadTimerHandle(GS144_Data,uid,2) != t then
+        call GS144_BootFinish(t,u)
+    else
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'BW44') > 0 then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,6,true)
+        endif
+        set ended = now >= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,1) or LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7)
+        if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,6) and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'BW44') == 0 then
+            set ended = true
+        endif
+        // Fail closed if the native item failed to apply its invisibility buff.
+        if now >= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,8)+0.50 and not LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,6) then
+            set ended = true
+        endif
+        if ended then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7,true)
+            call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0,false)
+            if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5) then
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'SW44')
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'BW45')
+                call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5,false)
+            endif
+            if not HaveSavedHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3) or now > LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,4) then
+                call GS144_BootFinish(t,u)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set u = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS144_BootUse takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local timer t
+    local real now
+    if GetItemTypeId(GetManipulatedItem()) != 'I01G' then
+        set u = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set t = LoadTimerHandle(GS144_Data,uid,2)
+    if t != null then
+        call GS144_BootFinish(t,u)
+    endif
+    set now = TimerGetElapsed(GS144_Clock)
+    set t = CreateTimer()
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS144_Data,GetHandleId(t),0,u)
+    call SaveTimerHandle(GS144_Data,uid,2,t)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0,true)
+    call SaveReal(GS144_Data,uid,1,now+7.00)
+    call SaveReal(GS144_Data,uid,8,now)
+    call UnitAddAbility(u,'SW44')
+    call BlzUnitHideAbility(u,'SW44',true)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5,true)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.05,true,function GS144_BootTick)
+    set t = null
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS144_BootAttack takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetAttacker()
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(GS144_Clock)
+    if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0) and now <= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,1) and not LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7) then
+        call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0,false)
+        call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7,true)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3,GetTriggerUnit())
+        // Preserve one committed ranged attack after invisibility ends.
+        call SaveReal(GS144_Data,uid,4,now+3.00)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS144_BootDamage takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetEventDamageSource()
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    if BlzGetEventIsAttack() and GetEventDamage() > 0.00 and LoadUnitHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3) == GetTriggerUnit() and TimerGetElapsed(GS144_Clock) <= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,4) then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3)
+        call BlzSetEventDamage(GetEventDamage()+100.00)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS144_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t = CreateTrigger()
+    local integer i = 0
+    set GS144_Data = InitHashtable()
+    set GS144_Clock = CreateTimer()
+    call TimerStart(GS144_Clock,1000000000.00,false,null)
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_USE_ITEM)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS144_BootUse)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ATTACKED)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS144_BootAttack)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(t,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGING,null)
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS144_BootDamage)
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+function GS114S_Band takes unit h returns integer
+    if GetHeroLevel(h) >= 15 then
+        return 3
+    elseif GetHeroLevel(h) >= 8 then
+        return 2
+    endif
+    return 1
+endfunction
+function GS114S_Enemy takes unit v, unit h returns boolean
+    return v != null and GetWidgetLife(v) > 0.405 and IsUnitEnemy(v, GetOwningPlayer(h)) and not IsUnitType(v, UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(v, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(v)
+endfunction
+function GS114S_StopSiege takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(h)
+    local unit a = LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data, k, 21)
+    local unit b = LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data, k, 22)
+    local timer duration = LoadTimerHandle(GS114S_Data,k,40)
+    local real remaining
+    call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data, k, 23, false)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data,k,42,false)
+    if duration != null then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS114S_Data,k,40)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(duration))
+        call PauseTimer(duration)
+        call DestroyTimer(duration)
+    endif
+    if HaveSavedReal(GS114S_Data,k,44) then
+        set remaining=RMaxBJ(0.0,LoadReal(GS114S_Data,k,44)-TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime))
+        if remaining>0.0 then
+            call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(h,'ASg1',remaining)
+        else
+            call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(h,'ASg1')
+        endif
+    endif
+    call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'ASf1',true)
+    if GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASs1') > 0 then
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'ASs1',false)
+    endif
+    set duration = null
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(GS114S_Data, k, 21)
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(GS114S_Data, k, 22)
+    if a != null then
+        call RemoveUnit(a)
+    endif
+    if b != null then
+        call RemoveUnit(b)
+    endif
+    call BlzUnitHideAbility(h, 'ASx1', true)
+    set a = null
+    set b = null
+endfunction
+function GS121_SiegeExpire takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local unit h = LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(t),41)
+    call GS114S_StopSiege(h)
+    set h = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS121_SiegeReady takes unit h returns nothing
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    call SaveTimerHandle(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(h),40,t)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(t),41,h)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(h),23,true)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(h),42,false)
+    call SaveReal(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(h),44,TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)+30.0)
+    call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(h,'ASg1',30.0)
+    call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'ASs1',true)
+    call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'ASf1',false)
+    call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'ASx1',false)
+    call TimerStart(t,600.0,false,function GS121_SiegeExpire)
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+function GS121_SiegeOrders takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer order = GetIssuedOrderId()
+    local integer key = GetHandleId(h)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h) == 'USa1' and LoadBoolean(GS114S_Data,key,23) then
+        if order == OrderId("clusterrockets") and LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,key,21) != null then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data,key,42,true)
+        elseif order != OrderId("berserk") and order != OrderId("channel") then
+            call GS114S_StopSiege(h)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h = null
+endfunction

+    if b != null then

+    set b = null

+        call GS114S_StopSiege(h)
+    endif
+    set h = null
+endfunction

+function GS121_Init takes nothing returns nothing

+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_CHANNEL)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS121_SiegeAction)
