+function GSPF_CreateBoard takes nothing returns nothing
+    local framehandle box = GSPF_Panel("GSPF_Board", 7002, 0.78, 0.43)
+    local framehandle f
+    local framehandle g
+    local trigger th = CreateTrigger()
+    local trigger tb = CreateTrigger()
+    local trigger tr = CreateTrigger()
+    local integer k = 0
+    local integer i
+    local integer grp
+    local integer j = 0
+    local integer last = -1
+    local real x
+    call BlzFrameSetAbsPoint(box, FRAMEPOINT_CENTER, 0.4, 0.36)
+    set f = GSPF_Text("GSPF_BoardTitle", 0, box, 0.3, 0.02)
+    call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, box, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, 0.024, -0.02)
+    call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_LEFT)
+    // 가운데 랜덤 버튼
+    set f = BlzCreateFrame("ScriptDialogButton", box, 0, 7310)
+    call BlzFrameSetSize(f, 0.17, 0.03)
+    call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOP, box, FRAMEPOINT_TOP, 0.0, -0.013)
+    call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(tr, f, FRAMEEVENT_CONTROL_CLICK)
+    call TriggerAddAction(tr, function GSPF_OnRandomClick)
+    set f = BlzCreateFrame("ScriptDialogButton", box, 0, 7300)
+    call BlzFrameSetSize(f, 0.07, 0.028)
+    call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPRIGHT, box, FRAMEPOINT_TOPRIGHT, -0.016, -0.014)
+    call BlzFrameSetText(f, "닫기")
+    call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(tb, f, FRAMEEVENT_CONTROL_CLICK)
+
+    // 진영 제목 (왼쪽 가디언 / 오른쪽 다크니스), 그룹 제목 (힘 / 민첩 / 지능)
+    loop
+        exitwhen k > 1
+        set f = GSPF_Text("GSPF_SideLbl", k, box, 0.37, 0.018)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, box, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, 0.024 + k * 0.385, -0.044)
+        call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_LEFT)
+        set k = k + 1
+    endloop
+    set k = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen k > 5
+        set f = GSPF_Text("GSPF_GrpLbl", k, box, 0.11, 0.016)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, box, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, 0.026 + (k / 3) * 0.385 + ModuloInteger(k, 3) * 0.123, -0.064)
+        call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_LEFT)
+        call BlzFrameSetText(f, GSPF_GroupLabel(k))
+        set k = k + 1
+    endloop
+
+    // 영웅 아이콘 버튼: 그룹마다 2열, 위에서 아래로
+    set i = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= GSPF_HeroCount()
+        set grp = GSPF_GroupOf(i)
+        if grp != last then
+            set j = 0
+            set last = grp
+        endif
+        set x = 0.024 + (grp / 3) * 0.385 + ModuloInteger(grp, 3) * 0.123 + ModuloInteger(j, 2) * 0.056
+        set f = BlzCreateFrame("ScoreScreenBottomButtonTemplate", box, 0, 7400 + i)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(f, 0.046, 0.046)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, box, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, x, -0.082 - (j / 2) * 0.052)
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(BlzGetFrameByName("ScoreScreenButtonBackdrop", 7400 + i), BlzGetAbilityIcon(GSPF_HeroAt(i)), 0, true)
+        call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(th, f, FRAMEEVENT_CONTROL_CLICK)
+        // 판매 시작 전 쿨다운: 위에서 아래로 걷히는 어두운 막 + 남은 초
+        set g = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSPF_Cd", f, "", 7400 + i)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(g, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, 0.0, 0.0)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(g, 0.046, 0.046)
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(g, "Textures\\Black32.blp", 0, true)
+        call BlzFrameSetAlpha(g, 175)
+        set g = GSPF_Text("GSPF_CdText", 7400 + i, f, 0.046, 0.046)
+        call BlzFrameSetAllPoints(g, f)
+        call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(g, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
+        call BlzFrameSetScale(g, 1.3)
+        // 툴팁: 영웅 이름
+        set g = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSPF_Tip", f, "", 7400 + i)
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(g, "Textures\\Black32.blp", 0, true)
+        call BlzFrameSetAlpha(g, 230)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(g, 0.14, 0.024)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(g, FRAMEPOINT_BOTTOM, f, FRAMEPOINT_TOP, 0.0, 0.004)
+        call BlzFrameSetTooltip(f, g)
+        set g = GSPF_Text("GSPF_TipText", 7400 + i, g, 0.14, 0.024)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(g, FRAMEPOINT_CENTER, BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_Tip", 7400 + i), FRAMEPOINT_CENTER, 0.0, 0.0)
+        call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(g, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
+        call BlzFrameSetText(g, "|cffffffff" + GetObjectName(GSPF_HeroAt(i)) + "|r")
+        set j = j + 1
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(th, function GSPF_OnHeroClick)
+
+    set f = GSPF_Text("GSPF_Hint", 0, box, 0.74, 0.018)
+    call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_BOTTOM, box, FRAMEPOINT_BOTTOM, 0.0, 0.014)
+    call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
+    call BlzFrameSetVisible(box, false)
+
+    // 닫기 버튼 / -보드 (다시 열기)
+    set k = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen k > 11
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent(tb, Player(k), "-보드", true)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent(tb, Player(k), "-board", true)
+        set k = k + 1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(tb, function GSPF_OnBoardCmd)
+    set box = null
+    set f = null
+    set g = null
+    set th = null
+    set tb = null
+    set tr = null
+endfunction
+
+function GSPF_Create takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer host = GSPF_FindHost()
+    call DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
+    call GSPF_Hidden("GSPF_Host", I2S(host))
+    call GSPF_Hidden("GSPF_Sel", "000000")
+    call GSPF_Hidden("GSPF_Done", "0")
+    call GSPF_Hidden("GSPF_Closed", "0")
+    call GSPF_Hidden("GSPF_RandPid", "0")
+    call GSPF_CreateBoard()
+    if host < 0 then
+        call GSPF_Confirm()
+        return
+    endif
+    call GSPF_CreateModeBox(host)
+    call GSPF_RefreshModes()
+    call PauseGame(true)
+endfunction
+
+function GSPF_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    // 영웅 목록(Set Variable Hero, 1초)과 위습 지급(Initialize, 1초) 이후에 시작
+    call TimerStart(CreateTimer(), 2.5, false, function GSPF_Create)
+endfunction

+function GSRI_ProbeShape takes integer front, integer payload, integer ranks, integer lengthField, integer endField returns nothing
+    local unit probe = CreateUnit(Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_PASSIVE),'e002',0.0,0.0,0.0)
+    local ability a
+    local integer lv = 0
+    call ShowUnit(probe,false)
+    call UnitAddAbility(probe,payload)
+    set a = BlzGetUnitAbility(probe,payload)
+    if a != null then
+        call SaveInteger(GSRI_Data,front,2,5)
+        loop
+            exitwhen lv >= ranks
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,front,200+lv*3,BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ABILITY_RLF_AREA_OF_EFFECT,lv))
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,front,201+lv*3,BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ConvertAbilityRealLevelField(lengthField),lv))
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,front,202+lv*3,BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ConvertAbilityRealLevelField(endField),lv))
+            set lv = lv+1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    call RemoveUnit(probe)
+    set probe = null
+    set a = null
+endfunction

+function GSRI_HideSegment takes integer i returns nothing
+    if GSRI_SegmentShown[i] then
+        call SetLightningColor(GSRI_Effect[i],0,0,0,0)
+        set GSRI_SegmentShown[i] = false
+    endif
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Hide takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i = 0
+    if GSRI_Visible then
+        loop
+            exitwhen i >= GSRI_POOL_SIZE
+            call GSRI_HideSegment(i)
+            set GSRI_SegmentValid[i] = false
+            set i = i+1
+        endloop
+        set GSRI_Visible = false
+    endif
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Cancel takes nothing returns nothing
+    set GSRI_Key = 0
+    set GSRI_LastAbility = 0
+    set GSRI_Caster = null
+    set GSRI_Item = null
+    set GSRI_CachedId = 0
+    set GSRI_YawValid = false
+    set GSRI_FindAge = 0.00
+    call GSRI_Hide()
+endfunction
+
+// Shortest angular path, including the -pi/pi seam. Never extrapolate aim.
+function GSRI_SmoothYaw takes real target returns real
+    local real delta
+    if not GSRI_YawValid then
+        set GSRI_Yaw = target
+        set GSRI_YawValid = true
+    else
+        set delta = Atan2(Sin(target-GSRI_Yaw), Cos(target-GSRI_Yaw))
+        if RAbsBJ(delta) < 0.001 then
+            set GSRI_Yaw = target
+        else
+            set GSRI_Yaw = GSRI_Yaw + delta*GSRI_TURN_BLEND
+            set GSRI_Yaw = Atan2(Sin(GSRI_Yaw), Cos(GSRI_Yaw))
+        endif
+    endif
+    return GSRI_Yaw
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Z takes real x, real y returns real
+    call MoveLocation(GSRI_Ground, x, y)
+    return GetLocationZ(GSRI_Ground) + 12.00
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Snapshot takes unit u returns nothing
+    local integer sid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer i = 0
+    local integer count = 0
+    local integer id
+    local integer lv
+    local integer offset
+    local integer profile
+    local integer lengthField
+    local integer endField
+    local ability a
+    local real range
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GSRI_Cache, sid)
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GSRI_CacheIndex, sid)
+    loop
+        set a = BlzGetUnitAbilityByIndex(u, i)
+        exitwhen a == null
+        set id = BlzGetAbilityId(a)
+        if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 1) != 0 and not HaveSavedInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex, sid, id) then
+            set offset = 1 + count*10
+            set lv = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, id)-1
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex, sid, id, offset)
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset, id)
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+1, lv)
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+2, BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(a, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_X))
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+3, BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(a, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_Y))
+            if lv >= 0 then
+                set range = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a, ABILITY_RLF_CAST_RANGE, lv)
+                set profile = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 2)
+                if profile == 4 then
+                    set range = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a, ConvertAbilityRealLevelField('Ebl1'), lv)
+                endif
+                call SaveReal(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+5, range)
+                // Query Channel-only fields only for Channel abilities.
+                if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 1) == 2 then
+                    call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+4, BlzGetAbilityIntegerLevelField(a, ConvertAbilityIntegerLevelField('Ncl2'), lv))
+                endif
+                call SaveReal(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+6, BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a, ABILITY_RLF_AREA_OF_EFFECT, lv))
+                if profile == 3 then
+                    set lengthField = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 3)
+                    set endField = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 4)
+                    if lengthField != 0 and endField != 0 then
+                        call SaveReal(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+7, BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a, ConvertAbilityRealLevelField(lengthField), lv))
+                        call SaveReal(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+8, BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a, ConvertAbilityRealLevelField(endField), lv))
+                    endif
+                endif
+            endif
+            set count = count+1
+        endif
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, 0, count)
+    set a = null
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_SnapshotTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i = 1
+    local integer sid
+    local unit u
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 12
+        set u = udg_HeroPlayer[i]
+        set sid = GetHandleId(u)
+        if GSRI_CacheOwner[i] != sid then
+            call FlushChildHashtable(GSRI_Cache, GSRI_CacheOwner[i])
+            call FlushChildHashtable(GSRI_CacheIndex, GSRI_CacheOwner[i])
+            set GSRI_CacheOwner[i] = sid
+        endif
+        if u != null and GetUnitTypeId(u) != 0 then
+            call GSRI_Snapshot(u)
+        endif
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Level takes unit u, integer id returns integer
+    local integer offset
+    if GSRI_Item != null then
+        return 0
+    endif
+    set offset = LoadInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex, GetHandleId(u), id)
+    if offset == 0 then
+        return -1
+    endif
+    return LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache, GetHandleId(u), offset+1)
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Range takes unit u, integer id, integer lv returns real
+    local integer offset
+    if GSRI_Item != null then
+        return LoadReal(GSRI_Data, id, 10)
+    endif
+    set offset = LoadInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex, GetHandleId(u), id)
+    if offset == 0 then
+        return 0.0
+    endif
+    return LoadReal(GSRI_Cache, GetHandleId(u), offset+5)
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_ItemSlot takes integer key returns integer
+    if key == 103 or key == 36 then
+        return 0
+    elseif key == 104 or key == 38 then
+        return 1
+    elseif key == 100 or key == 37 then
+        return 2
+    elseif key == 101 or key == 12 then
+        return 3
+    elseif key == 97 or key == 35 then
+        return 4
+    elseif key == 98 or key == 40 then
+        return 5
+    endif
+    return -1
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_FindItem takes unit u, integer slot returns integer
+    local item it=UnitItemInSlot(u,slot)
+    local integer found=0
+    if it!=null then
+        set found=LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,GetItemTypeId(it),100)
+    endif
+    if found!=0 then
+        set GSRI_Item=it
+    else
+        set GSRI_Item=null
+    endif
+    set it=null
+    return found
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Allowed takes unit u, integer id returns boolean
+    local integer kind = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 1)
+    local integer level = GSRI_Level(u, id)
+    local integer sid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer offset = LoadInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex, sid, id)
+    local real range
+    if kind == 0 or level < 0 then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if GSRI_Item == null then
+        if offset == 0 then
+            return false
+        endif
+        if LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+2) < 0 or LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+3) < 0 then
+            return false
+        endif
+        if kind == 2 and LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+4) == 0 then
+            return false
+        endif
+    endif
+    set range = GSRI_Range(u,id,level)
+    return range > 0.00 and range < 9999.00
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Find takes unit u, integer key returns integer
+    local integer sid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer i = 0
+    local integer count = LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, 0)
+    local integer id
+    local integer found = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= count
+        set id = LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, 1+i*10)
+        if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 0) == key and GSRI_Allowed(u, id) then
+            if found != 0 and found != id then
+                return 0
+            endif
+            set found = id
+        endif
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    return found
+endfunction
+
+// Sample both ends and midpoint. Do not draw a diagonal bridge over cliffs.
+function GSRI_Segment takes real x1, real y1, real x2, real y2 returns nothing
+    local integer i = GSRI_DrawIndex
+    local real dx = x2-x1
+    local real dy = y2-y1
+    local real length = SquareRoot(dx*dx+dy*dy)
+    local real z1
+    local real z2
+    local real zm
+    if i >= GSRI_POOL_SIZE then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GSRI_DrawIndex = i+1
+    if GSRI_SegmentValid[i] and GSRI_X1[i] == x1 and GSRI_Y1[i] == y1 and GSRI_X2[i] == x2 and GSRI_Y2[i] == y2 then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GSRI_X1[i] = x1
+    set GSRI_Y1[i] = y1
+    set GSRI_X2[i] = x2
+    set GSRI_Y2[i] = y2
+    set GSRI_SegmentValid[i] = true
+    set z1 = GSRI_Z(x1,y1)
+    set z2 = GSRI_Z(x2,y2)
+    set zm = GSRI_Z((x1+x2)*0.5,(y1+y2)*0.5)
+    if length < 0.01 or RAbsBJ(z2-z1) > 64.00 or RAbsBJ(zm-z1) > 64.00 or RAbsBJ(z2-zm) > 64.00 or RAbsBJ(zm-(z1+z2)*0.5) > 12.00 then
+        call GSRI_HideSegment(i)
+        return
+    endif
+    // False bypasses fog visibility checks; it grants no terrain/unit vision.
+    call MoveLightningEx(GSRI_Effect[i],false,x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2)
+    if not GSRI_SegmentShown[i] then
+        if i < GSRI_RING_LIMIT then
+            call SetLightningColor(GSRI_Effect[i],0.294,0.765,1.00,0.78)
+        else
+            call SetLightningColor(GSRI_Effect[i],0.275,1.00,0.745,0.78)
+        endif
+        set GSRI_SegmentShown[i] = true
+    endif
+endfunction
+
+// At most 48 world units between terrain samples along a straight edge.
+function GSRI_Line takes real x1, real y1, real x2, real y2 returns nothing
+    local real dx = x2-x1
+    local real dy = y2-y1
+    local integer n = R2I(SquareRoot(dx*dx+dy*dy)/48.00)+1
+    local integer j = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen j >= n
+        call GSRI_Segment(x1+dx*j/n,y1+dy*j/n,x1+dx*(j+1)/n,y1+dy*(j+1)/n)
+        set j = j+1
+    endloop
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_PathLine takes real x1, real y1, real x2, real y2 returns nothing
+    call GSRI_Line(GSRI_OriginX+x1*GSRI_Cos-y1*GSRI_Sin,GSRI_OriginY+x1*GSRI_Sin+y1*GSRI_Cos,GSRI_OriginX+x2*GSRI_Cos-y2*GSRI_Sin,GSRI_OriginY+x2*GSRI_Sin+y2*GSRI_Cos)
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Trim takes integer oldEnd returns nothing
+    local integer i = GSRI_DrawIndex
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= oldEnd
+        call GSRI_HideSegment(i)
+        set GSRI_SegmentValid[i] = false
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Draw takes unit u, integer id returns nothing
+    local integer sid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer offset = LoadInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex,sid,id)
+    local integer lv = GSRI_Level(u,id)
+    local real radius = GSRI_Range(u,id,lv)
+    local real x = GetUnitX(u)
+    local real y = GetUnitY(u)
+    local real dx = GSRI_MouseX-x
+    local real dy = GSRI_MouseY-y
+    local real yaw
+    local real angle1
+    local real angle2
+    local real startWidth = 125.00
+    local integer n = R2I(2.00*bj_PI*radius/48.00)+1
+    local integer j = 0
+    local integer profile = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,id,2)
+    local real reach = 0.0
+    local real endWidth = 0.0
+    local real pointX
+    local real pointY
+    local real distance
+    if GSRI_MouseValid and dx*dx+dy*dy > 0.01 then
+        set yaw = GSRI_SmoothYaw(Atan2(dy,dx))
+    else
+        set yaw = 0.0
+    endif
+    set GSRI_CacheAge = GSRI_CacheAge + GSRI_PERIOD
+    if GSRI_CachedId == id and GSRI_CachedLevel == lv and GSRI_CachedX == x and GSRI_CachedY == y and GSRI_CachedRadius == radius and (profile == 0 or profile == 4 or GSRI_CachedYaw == yaw) and GSRI_CacheAge < 0.25 then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GSRI_RingDirty = GSRI_CachedId != id or GSRI_CachedLevel != lv or GSRI_CachedX != x or GSRI_CachedY != y or GSRI_CachedRadius != radius or GSRI_CacheAge >= 0.25
+    if GSRI_CacheAge >= 0.25 then
+        set j = 0
+        loop
+            exitwhen j >= GSRI_POOL_SIZE
+            set GSRI_SegmentValid[j] = false
+            set j = j+1
+        endloop
+        set j = 0
+    endif
+    set GSRI_CachedId = id
+    set GSRI_CachedLevel = lv
+    set GSRI_CachedX = x
+    set GSRI_CachedY = y
+    set GSRI_CachedRadius = radius
+    set GSRI_CachedYaw = yaw
+    set GSRI_CacheAge = 0.0
+    if not GSRI_Visible then
+        set GSRI_ShowCount = GSRI_ShowCount+1
+        set GSRI_Visible = true
+    endif
+    if n > GSRI_RING_LIMIT then
+        set n = GSRI_RING_LIMIT
+    endif
+    set GSRI_LastRange = radius
+    set GSRI_DrawIndex = 0
+    if GSRI_RingDirty then
+    loop
+        exitwhen j >= n
+        set angle1 = 2.00*bj_PI*j/n
+        set angle2 = 2.00*bj_PI*(j+1)/n
+        call GSRI_Segment(x+radius*Cos(angle1),y+radius*Sin(angle1),x+radius*Cos(angle2),y+radius*Sin(angle2))
+        set j = j+1
+    endloop
+    call GSRI_Trim(GSRI_RingCount)
+    set GSRI_RingCount = GSRI_DrawIndex
+    endif
+    set GSRI_DrawIndex = GSRI_RING_LIMIT
+    if (profile == 2 or profile == 3 or profile == 5) and GSRI_MouseValid and dx*dx+dy*dy > 0.01 then
+        set GSRI_OriginX = x
+        set GSRI_OriginY = y
+        set GSRI_Cos = Cos(yaw)
+        set GSRI_Sin = Sin(yaw)
+        if profile == 2 then
+            call GSRI_PathLine(0,-120,1170,-120)
+            call GSRI_PathLine(0,120,1170,120)
+            call GSRI_PathLine(0,0,1170,0)
+            set j = 0
+            loop
+                exitwhen j >= 12
+                set angle1 = bj_PI*0.5+bj_PI*j/12
+                set angle2 = bj_PI*0.5+bj_PI*(j+1)/12
+                call GSRI_PathLine(120*Cos(angle1),120*Sin(angle1),120*Cos(angle2),120*Sin(angle2))
+                call GSRI_PathLine(1170-120*Cos(angle1),-120*Sin(angle1),1170-120*Cos(angle2),-120*Sin(angle2))
+                set j = j+1
+            endloop
+        else
+            set startWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,20)
+            if GSRI_Item == null and offset != 0 then
+                set startWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+6)
+            endif
+            set reach = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,21)
+            set endWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,22)
+            if GSRI_Item == null and offset != 0 then
+                set reach = LoadReal(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+7)
+                set endWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+8)
+            endif
+            if profile == 5 then
+                if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,id,5) == 1 then
+                    set lv = ModuloInteger(lv,4)
+                endif
+                set startWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,200+lv*3)
+                set reach = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,201+lv*3)
+                set endWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,202+lv*3)
+            endif
+            if reach > 0.0 and reach < 9999.0 and startWidth >= 0.0 and endWidth >= 0.0 then
+                call GSRI_PathLine(0,-startWidth,reach,-endWidth)
+                call GSRI_PathLine(0,startWidth,reach,endWidth)
+                call GSRI_PathLine(0,-startWidth,0,startWidth)
+                call GSRI_PathLine(reach,-endWidth,reach,endWidth)
+                call GSRI_PathLine(0,0,reach,0)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    if profile == 6 and GSRI_MouseValid then
+        set distance=SquareRoot(dx*dx+dy*dy)
+        set pointX=GSRI_MouseX
+        set pointY=GSRI_MouseY
+        if distance>radius and distance>0.0 then
+            set pointX=x+dx*radius/distance
+            set pointY=y+dy*radius/distance
+        endif
+        set startWidth=225.0
+        if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(u),'RD04',true)>0 then
+            set startWidth=300.0
+        endif
+        set j=0
+        loop
+            exitwhen j>=48
+            set angle1=2.0*bj_PI*I2R(j)/48.0
+            set angle2=2.0*bj_PI*I2R(j+1)/48.0
+            call GSRI_Segment(pointX+startWidth*Cos(angle1),pointY+startWidth*Sin(angle1),pointX+startWidth*Cos(angle2),pointY+startWidth*Sin(angle2))
+            set j=j+1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    call GSRI_Trim(GSRI_PathCount)
+    set GSRI_PathCount = GSRI_DrawIndex
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_Tick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u
+    local integer id
+    local integer slot
+    local integer hover = -1
+    set slot = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen slot >= 6
+        if GSRI_ItemHover[slot] != null and BlzFrameIsVisible(GSRI_ItemHover[slot]) then
+            set hover = slot
+            exitwhen true
+        endif
+        set slot = slot+1
+    endloop
+    if GSRI_Enabled and hover >= 0 and hover != GSRI_LastHover then
+        set GSRI_PendingSlot = hover
+    endif
+    set GSRI_LastHover = hover
+    if GSRI_PendingSlot >= 0 then
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+        if GSRI_PendingSlot == 0 then
+            set GSRI_Key = 103
+        elseif GSRI_PendingSlot == 1 then
+            set GSRI_Key = 104
+        elseif GSRI_PendingSlot == 2 then
+            set GSRI_Key = 100
+        elseif GSRI_PendingSlot == 3 then
+            set GSRI_Key = 101
+        elseif GSRI_PendingSlot == 4 then
+            set GSRI_Key = 97
+        else
+            set GSRI_Key = 98
+        endif
+        set GSRI_PendingSlot = -1
+        set GSRI_Age = 0.0
+    endif
+    if GSRI_Key == 0 or not GSRI_Enabled then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GSRI_Age = GSRI_Age + GSRI_PERIOD
+    set GSRI_FindAge = GSRI_FindAge + GSRI_PERIOD
+    set u = udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())+1]
+    if not BlzIsLocalClientActive() or GSRI_Age > 30.00 or u == null or GetWidgetLife(u) <= 0.405 or not IsUnitSelected(u, GetLocalPlayer()) or (GSRI_Caster != null and GSRI_Caster != u) then
+        set GSRI_Reason = "hero/selection/focus/timeout"
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+        set u = null
+        return
+    endif
+    // Resolve immediately on key press; refresh bindings at 8 Hz, render at 64 Hz.
+    set id = GSRI_LastAbility
+    if id == 0 or GSRI_FindAge >= 0.125 then
+        set slot = GSRI_ItemSlot(GSRI_Key)
+        if slot >= 0 then
+            set id = GSRI_FindItem(u,slot)
+        else
+            set GSRI_Item = null
+            set id = GSRI_Find(u, GSRI_Key)
+        endif
+        set GSRI_FindAge = 0.00
+    endif
+    if GSRI_Item != null and UnitItemInSlot(u,GSRI_ItemSlot(GSRI_Key)) != GSRI_Item then
+        set id = 0
+    endif
+    if id != 0 then
+        if not GSRI_Allowed(u,id) then
+            set id = 0
+        endif
+    endif
+    if id == 0 then
+        set GSRI_Reason = "ability unavailable or ambiguous"
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    else
+        set GSRI_Reason = "display"
+        set GSRI_Caster = u
+        set GSRI_LastAbility = id
+        call GSRI_Draw(u,id)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_OnKey takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer key = GetHandleId(BlzGetTriggerPlayerKey())
+    if GetTriggerPlayer() != GetLocalPlayer() then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GSRI_PendingSlot = -1
+    set GSRI_KeyCount = GSRI_KeyCount+1
+    set GSRI_Reason = "key " + I2S(key)
+    // Native oskey events are suppressed while chat owns focus. Never infer
+    // chat state by toggling Enter: the closing Enter/Escape can be absent.
+    if key == 13 then
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    elseif key == 27 then
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    elseif key == 112 or key == 119 or key == 79 then
+        // Selection/talent/learn screens must not retain the previous preview.
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    else
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+        set GSRI_Key = key
+        set GSRI_Age = 0.00
+        call GSRI_Tick()
+    endif
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_OnMouse takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetTriggerPlayer() != GetLocalPlayer() then
+        return
+    endif
+    if GetTriggerEventId() == EVENT_PLAYER_MOUSE_MOVE then
+        set GSRI_MouseX = BlzGetTriggerPlayerMouseX()
+        set GSRI_MouseY = BlzGetTriggerPlayerMouseY()
+        set GSRI_MouseValid = true
+    else
+        set GSRI_Reason = "mouse click"
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+        if BlzGetTriggerPlayerMouseButton() == MOUSE_BUTTON_TYPE_LEFT and GSRI_LastHover >= 0 then
+            set GSRI_PendingSlot = GSRI_LastHover
+        endif
+    endif
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_OnSpell takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetTriggerUnit() == GSRI_Caster then
+        set GSRI_Reason = "cast or deselect"
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    endif
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_OnChat takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetTriggerPlayer() == GetLocalPlayer() then
+        if GetEventPlayerChatString() == "-range" then
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(),0,0,20,"GSRI ver144 keys="+I2S(GSRI_KeyCount)+" shows="+I2S(GSRI_ShowCount)+" range="+R2S(GSRI_LastRange)+" last="+GSRI_Reason)
+        endif
+        if GetEventPlayerChatString() == "-range off" then
+            set GSRI_PendingSlot = -1
+            set GSRI_Enabled = false
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(),0,0,5,"범위 표시 OFF")
+        elseif GetEventPlayerChatString() == "-range on" then
+            set GSRI_Enabled = true
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(),0,0,5,"범위 표시 ON")
+        endif
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    endif
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_OnInventory takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetTriggerPlayer() == GetLocalPlayer() and GSRI_Enabled then
+        set GSRI_PendingSlot = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,GetHandleId(BlzGetTriggerFrame()),101)-1
+    endif
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_OnItemCommand takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u
+    local item it
+    local integer aid = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,GetHandleId(GetTriggeringTrigger()),102)
+    local integer slot = 0
+    if GetTriggerPlayer() != GetLocalPlayer() or not GSRI_Enabled then
+        return
+    endif
+    set u = udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())+1]
+    if u == null or not IsUnitSelected(u,GetLocalPlayer()) then
+        set u = null
+        return
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen slot >= 6
+        set it = UnitItemInSlot(u,slot)
+        if it != null and LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,GetItemTypeId(it),100) == aid then
+            set GSRI_PendingSlot = slot
+            exitwhen true
+        endif
+        set slot = slot+1
+    endloop
+    set it = null
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_RegisterItemCommand takes integer aid, string order returns nothing
+    local trigger t = CreateTrigger()
+    call SaveInteger(GSRI_Data,GetHandleId(t),102,aid)
+    call TriggerRegisterCommandEvent(t,aid,order)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GSRI_OnItemCommand)
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+
+function GSRI_ItemProbeTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer aid
+    local ability a
+    local real range=0.0
+    if GSRI_ItemProbeIndex>=GSRI_ItemProbeCount then
+        call RemoveUnit(GSRI_ItemProbeUnit)
+        set GSRI_ItemProbeUnit=null
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    set aid=GSRI_ItemProbeIds[GSRI_ItemProbeIndex]
+    call UnitAddAbility(GSRI_ItemProbeUnit,aid)
+    set a=BlzGetUnitAbility(GSRI_ItemProbeUnit,aid)
+    if a!=null then
+        if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,aid,2)==4 then
+            set range=BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ConvertAbilityRealLevelField('Ebl1'),0)
+        else
+            set range=BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ABILITY_RLF_CAST_RANGE,0)
+        endif
+        if range>0.0 and range<9999.0 then
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,aid,10,range)
+        endif
+    endif
+    call UnitRemoveAbility(GSRI_ItemProbeUnit,aid)
+    set GSRI_ItemProbeIndex=GSRI_ItemProbeIndex+1
+    set a=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+

+function GS144_BootFinish takes timer t, unit u returns nothing
+    local integer key = GetHandleId(t)
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    if u != null and LoadTimerHandle(GS144_Data,uid,2) == t then
+        if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5) then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'SW44')
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'BW45')
+        endif
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS144_Data,uid)
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS144_Data,key)
+    call PauseTimer(t)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+endfunction
+
+function GS144_BootTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local unit u = LoadUnitHandle(GS144_Data,GetHandleId(t),0)
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(GS144_Clock)
+    local boolean ended = false
+    if u == null or GetUnitTypeId(u) == 0 or GetWidgetLife(u) <= 0.405 or LoadTimerHandle(GS144_Data,uid,2) != t then
+        call GS144_BootFinish(t,u)
+    else
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'BW44') > 0 then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,6,true)
+        endif
+        set ended = now >= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,1) or LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7)
+        if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,6) and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'BW44') == 0 then
+            set ended = true
+        endif
+        // Fail closed if the native item failed to apply its invisibility buff.
+        if now >= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,8)+0.50 and not LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,6) then
+            set ended = true
+        endif
+        if ended then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7,true)
+            call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0,false)
+            if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5) then
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'SW44')
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'BW45')
+                call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5,false)
+            endif
+            if not HaveSavedHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3) or now > LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,4) then
+                call GS144_BootFinish(t,u)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set u = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS144_BootUse takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local timer t
+    local real now
+    if GetItemTypeId(GetManipulatedItem()) != 'I01G' then
+        set u = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set t = LoadTimerHandle(GS144_Data,uid,2)
+    if t != null then
+        call GS144_BootFinish(t,u)
+    endif
+    set now = TimerGetElapsed(GS144_Clock)
+    set t = CreateTimer()
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS144_Data,GetHandleId(t),0,u)
+    call SaveTimerHandle(GS144_Data,uid,2,t)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0,true)
+    call SaveReal(GS144_Data,uid,1,now+7.00)
+    call SaveReal(GS144_Data,uid,8,now)
+    call UnitAddAbility(u,'SW44')
+    call BlzUnitHideAbility(u,'SW44',true)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5,true)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.05,true,function GS144_BootTick)
+    set t = null
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS144_BootAttack takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetAttacker()
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(GS144_Clock)
+    if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0) and now <= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,1) and not LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7) then
+        call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0,false)
+        call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7,true)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3,GetTriggerUnit())
+        // Preserve one committed ranged attack after invisibility ends.
+        call SaveReal(GS144_Data,uid,4,now+3.00)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS144_BootDamage takes nothing returns nothing

+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3)
+        call BlzSetEventDamage(GetEventDamage()+100.00)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS144_Init takes nothing returns nothing

+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS144_BootAttack)

+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(t,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGING,null)
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS144_BootDamage)
+    set t = null
+endfunction

==============================================================================
11. 검증 한계와 테스트 체크리스트
==============================================================================
이 메모는 최초 F8FKfix 파일에서 최신 ver139까지의 누적 실제 차이다. 중간에 추가됐다가 다시 제거된 변경은 최종 맵 차이에 없을 수 있다.
변경이 없는 원본 바이너리 리소스 1048개를 다시 수정사항으로 나열하지 않고 SAME으로 증명했다.
임의의 버전별 의도·작업자·인게임 성능을 추정하지 않았다. 신규/변경 스킬 상세 수치는 5절과 6절, 실제 처리 코드는 7절과 8절을 참고한다.
실게임 테스트: 동일 파일을 모든 참가자가 사용; 산투 Q→징벌의 칼날 반복; 각자 스킬/아이템 사거리 표시 동시 사용; 변신/부활/스킬 습득 직후.
피와케 E 1~4레벨, 정상 수명/빠른 사망/고장 특성 비교. 최근 수정한 아이템별 단축키·클릭·호버 확인.
월드 에디터로 다시 저장한 맵도 별도로 테스트해야 한다. 이 보고서는 그 재저장 결과를 검증한 것이 아니다.
